LANDED. Gerrit change 1606 MERGED, on main as 586dca014c (Gerrit rebased on submit). Gates: LLM-Review +1 PASS (1 advisory, non-blocking) and Verified +1 CI SUCCESS (run 31556896039), both on patchset 3.

All six ACs re-verified against the MERGED tree (not the pre-push tree):
- AC1: pytest tests/unit/test_reconcile_bridge_canary_class.py -> 3 passed standalone
- AC2: both sites carry sys.path.insert + __file__ above the import -> exit 0
- AC3: AST sweep matches the five documented sites exactly -> OK
- AC4: tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py -> 2 passed
- AC5: insert removed -> 2 failed, reproducing the original '1 passed, 2 errors' ModuleNotFoundError; restored -> 2 passed
- AC6: make lint + make typecheck clean; tests/unit + tests/scripts -> 10133 passed, 38 skipped, exit 0

Process note for the record: three patchsets were pushed. Patchsets 2 and 3 were prose/naming accuracy fixes (a comment and a test name both said the failure happens 'at collection' when it happens at fixture setup), and pushing them CANCELLED the in-flight CI on patchset 1, costing a CI cycle. Those fixes should have been batched before the first push.
